metadata.public_description: A practical Tuesday evening exploring Money Mindset × AI Skillset with Edmund Lin.

public_content.heading: A fresh week. Practical ideas to put to work.
paragraphs: Join Edmund for a focused evening bringing money mindset and practical AI skills into the same conversation. Explore ways to think more clearly about money, use AI in everyday work, and turn useful ideas into small actions.
Bring your questions and your curiosity. There will be room for conversation, examples and connecting with others. No prior AI experience is required.
public_content.reminder: Remember to have your dinner before coming over!
